name: Ripple Bull Winkle
text: 5,000+ XRP holders, builders, and industry leaders packed into one room at XRP Seoul 2025. The ecosystem is way bigger than most people realize. Seoul is one of the strongest $XRP communities on the planet.
quoted_text:
5,000+ XRP holders, builders, and industry leaders under one roof. The XRP ecosystem is growing beyond the charts. 
  
Looking forward to seeing what XRP Seoul 2027 brings.
claim: More than 5,000 XRP holders, builders, and industry leaders attended XRP Seoul 2025.
on_record: No independent report found confirming a 5,000-plus attendance figure for XRP Seoul 2025. The rest of the post is a subjective view of community strength.
